components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;border:1px solid var(--outline);border-radius:100px;padding:12px 24px;font:600 .875rem Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--primary);background:transparent;cursor:pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--state-hover); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--primary);outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button:active { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 100px var(--state-pressed); } .ds-primary { background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-ink); } .ds-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary),white 8%); }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;border:1px solid var(--outline);border-radius:100px;padding:12px 24px;font:600 .875rem Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--primary);background:transparent;cursor:pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--state-hover); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--primary);outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button:active { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 100px var(--state-pressed); }

components.name: Outlined input
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid;gap:8px;font: .875rem Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted); } .ds-field input { min-height:56px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--outline);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text);background:transparent;font:1rem Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--primary);outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Navigation tab
components.css: .ds-tab { border:0;border-bottom:3px solid var(--primary);padding:16px 24px;min-height:56px;color:var(--primary);background:transparent;font:600 .875rem Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-tab:hover { background:var(--state-hover); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--primary);outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Activity day
components.description: Keyboard and touch accessible listening activity.

narrative.overview:
A calm, readable listening notebook. The owner confirmed this description and the
existing Material Design 3 identity. Preserve local Inter, lavender accents, tonal
surfaces and clear controls while helping people understand their own music data.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet tonal depth, clear focus and restrained color.
Consistent controls for file import, analysis and history search.
Light and dark variants with the same hierarchy and behavior.

rules.name: The Paired Ink Rule
rules.body: Every colored control uses its corresponding foreground token. Canvas marks, ticks, grids, fills and tooltips must change with the theme.

dos: Do preserve the Material Design 3 identity and local font/icon delivery.
Do pair semantic colors with text labels and accessible states.
Do verify imports, errors, both themes and narrow layouts with real rendered output.
Do preserve data, filter state and calendar selection when switching theme or tabs.
donts: Don't persist listening history or API keys with the theme preference.
Don't reset the session through the brand link or a failed import.
Don't hardcode canvas colors or use tiny text for essential supporting information.
Don't infer lifetime behavior from gaps or first appearances in imported files.
